inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: One of the slides in the school-age playground has a crack and there is a layer of the material hanging from underneath the structure. The top surface of the younger playground structure has peeling material exposing the metal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Gas Leak Inspection - Liquid Propane: Last gas leak inspection was conducted on 05/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Gas Leak Inspection - Liquid Propane (26 TAC §746.5403(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver caring for a group of children was missing 16 hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver in a odder room was heard yelling at children as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children in the afterschool room were observed watching a show on the television. The show playing (Lemonade Mouth) was not related to the planned activities. Two children were observed playing roblox games on tablets and a third child was observed playing a fighting game on a tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent Child Care Regulation inspection form was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: The activity plans posted in both infant rooms, and both toddler rooms were not current. The activity plan in one infant room had a date for the month of October 2023. The activity plan for the second infant room had a date of May 2023. In the toddler rooms the dates of the activity plans posted were from November 13, 2023 and August 2023.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the current activity plans were obtained for each room and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 6 children's immunization records reviewed was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A seat in one of the transportation vehicles was observed with several tearing exposing the foam material inside of the seat.  This posed a safety hazard as the foam material was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was caring for 5 infants in the infant room. The specified age of the children in the group was between 0-11 months of age. According to the child/caregiver ratio chart, the maximum number of children a caregiver may supervise is 4.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A 17 month old infant and a 19 month toddler were observed with a group of children watching a movie during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: A soiled diaper was observed in a trash container without a cover.         Note: A new trash bag was placed in the container and caregivers were notified to use the diaper genie to dispose of soiled diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 16 month old infant and a 17 momth old infant were grouped together with older children.  in The oldest child in the group was 10 years old and the youngest child was 16 months old. The oldest child in the group was more than 18 months older than the youngest child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on a child when the caregiver yelled at a child and forced a child to get up by grabbing the child from their arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when the caregiver allowed several children in care push the caregiver around on a skateboard in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that children were not adequately supervised when a caregiver allowed older children to carry younger children while the caregiver was riding on a skateboard in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: An uncovered container with food was observed in the refrigerator.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the food in the container was discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Three cribs were not labeled with the assigned infant's name.        Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the cribs were labeled with the infant's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan); your policies must include:    (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;    (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;    (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;    (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;    (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and    (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Activity Area: The number of infants in care exceeded the infant room's activity space. There were a total of 6 infants in care with two caregivers during the inspection. Based on the space measurements for that infant room the maximum number of children is 5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Activity Area (26 TAC §746.4205(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: The immunization record reviewed for 1 of 6 children's files were not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Three infants were sleeping on a restrictive device (floor bouncers) for an undetermined amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: A caregiver's file was not available for review during the inspection. A caregiver's  education documentation was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A mop bucket containing water was observed in the afterschool classroom area accessible to children.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the bucket was removed from the room area and placed outside out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver who conducts transportation did not have current training in transportation safety. The certificate of training available for review had a date of completion 5/16/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
